evidence: rollback.md:96 says "Run `npm run migrate -- down` before deploying the reverted code". The down migration rebuilds notes with `id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY` (no AUTOINCREMENT) and runs `DELETE FROM sqlite_sequence WHERE name = 'notes'`. rollback.md:88 says that without AUTOINCREMENT "a repeated `DELETE` of the old id would remove the newer note". The same file also says leaving the migration in place after the code revert "does no harm", so the safe order is to revert the code first and then run the migration down.
